proposal.reason: Main change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated, defaulted, env-overridden, stored, and synchronized across ranks. Enqueue also needs review because graphUsageMode changes strong-stream acquire/release and P2P plan batching/error behavior in host-side scheduling. Device-topology needs review because P2P per-peer/network channel computation now depends on nChannelsPerNetPeer/maxP2pPeers and argument-budget caps.
